title: Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 (Europe): CDON calls
summary: Skip the two matching SMPC CDON calls while retaining their delay slots.
rationale: Preserve the original SAROO compatibility edit on this exact disc source, with complete FILE hash, raw-sector and preimage guards. See doc/OCTOBER-REVISION-PROFILES.md for source, instruction, callback-delivery evidence and timing/audio/physical limits. Keep opt-in with the original callback available.

writes.effect: Replace JSR @R8 with NOP; retain MOV #8,R4 in its delay slot.
writes.reason: The shared helper writes argument 8 to SMPC COMREG, which issues CDON and enables the native drive. Preserve the inherited SAROO compatibility workaround on this exact European revision.
